name: internal-poc-monorepo
description: Monorepo interne — apps POC + packages partagés conformes à STANDARD_POC.md.

scripts.dev:ftm: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "cd apps/ftm/backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "pnpm --filter @apps/ftm-frontend dev"
scripts.dev:pdf-reviewer: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "cd apps/pdf-reviewer/backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001" "pnpm --filter @apps/pdf-reviewer-frontend dev"
scripts.dev:doc-writer: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "cd apps/doc-writer/backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002" "pnpm --filter @apps/doc-writer-frontend dev"
scripts.dev:ocr-vision: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "cd apps/ocr-vision/backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8003" "pnpm --filter @apps/ocr-vision-frontend dev"
